sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: application documents, fees, renewal and address rules
Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 21 to 27; part C2 holds 16 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-APP-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-APP-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-APP-D-XMFEE — TDL motorcycle (XM) total in prose disagrees with the fee table (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-APP-D-GUARD — which provision the National Guard and military-family footnote limits (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-APP-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-APP-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: fees, payment methods, websites and mailing addresses (for example sec02-F25, sec02-F31, sec02-F37) can change and must be refreshed from the Department of Safety and Homeland Security website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
